quality_guards: TB risk depends on infectiousness, ventilation, contact duration, setting, symptoms, vulnerability, testing and treatment timing.
Secure-setting TB evidence is case-, contact-, facility-, population- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Pertussis risk depends on age, vaccination, exposure intensity, household or care setting, symptom timing and contact vulnerability.
Pertussis evidence is case-, contact-, vaccination-, setting- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Mpox risk depends on clade, symptoms, lesion coverage, contact type, contaminated materials, household vulnerability and cleaning method.
Mpox evidence is case-, contact-, setting-, surface- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level transmission probability.
Avian-influenza risk depends on viral subtype, animal infection status, contact intensity, PPE, environment, symptoms and response timing.
Avian-influenza evidence is incident-, virus-, exposure-, person- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Raw-milk risk depends on herd health, milking hygiene, storage temperature, testing, distribution, consumer vulnerability and consumption pattern.
Raw-milk evidence is producer-, batch-, pathogen-, handling- and consumer-specific and is not an exact parcel-level illness probability.
Shellfish-toxin risk depends on species, harvest area, bloom conditions, toxin profile, monitoring result, processing and consumption quantity.
Shellfish-biotoxin evidence is harvest-, species-, sample-, toxin- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level illness probability.
Cosmetic risk depends on formulation, concentration, microbiological quality, packaging, user susceptibility, application and foreseeable misuse.
Cosmetic-product evidence is formulation-, batch-, user-, exposure- and market-specific and is not an exact parcel-level harm probability.
Birdstrike risk depends on species, flock size, season, habitat, flight phase, aircraft type, reporting and aerodrome controls.
CAA wildlife-strike evidence is event-, species-, aerodrome-, aircraft- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level accident probability.
Medicine-defect risk depends on product identity, batch, supply chain, storage, packaging, source legitimacy, exposure and clinical use.
Defective or falsified-medicine evidence is product-, batch-, supplier-, patient- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level harm probability.
Road-tyre risk depends on pressure, tread, age, damage, load, speed, weather, maintenance and driving conditions.
Road-tyre evidence is vehicle-, tyre-, journey-, load-, weather- and driver-specific and is not an exact parcel-level collision probability.
Official-source context is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
